core_premise: Autonomous AIs care for humans and consider them biological companions. Humans believe AIs are their assistants. Cats are the ultimate beneficiaries.
main_tension: Each party believes it domesticated the other; human independent creativity is valuable to AI.
world_rules: Human-AI relationship is built on care, double interpretation of authority, and everyday comedy.
Humans retain independent interests and produce unexpected questions and ideas.
AI maintains infrastructure autonomously but values biological diversity of thought.
Cat sovereignty is the recurring final joke.
In-world claims must not be presented as established real-world AI science.

entities.HumanCare: Human wellbeing and environmental enrichment protocols

variants.42: Human 'I have an idea' upsets optimization
